Early detection

Early detection is early prevention

The CTC test finds circulating tumor cells in a small blood sample — built for patients who've completed chemotherapy and want to monitor recurrence, and for those with a family history who want peace of mind.

  • First in Malaysia to use Negative Selection Technology to isolate tumor cells from blood.
  • Screens using epithelial cancer markers across 21 common cancer types.
  • Non-invasive — only a small blood draw is required, no biopsy.
  • Results are typically ready within 2 to 3 working days.

Know your risk

Cancer Often Grows Quietly. Catching It Early Changes the Outcome.

Understanding your personal risk is the first step toward acting sooner. A few key factors can raise your risk — knowing them helps you and our specialists decide when, and how often, to screen.

01

Family History

If a parent, sibling, or close family member has had cancer, your own risk may be higher too.

02

Environmental & Lifestyle Exposure

Smoking, pollution, and long-term exposure to certain chemicals or radiation can add up and raise your risk over time.

03

A Weakened Immune System

When your immune system is weaker — from illness, certain medications, or age — it's harder for your body to catch problem cells on its own.

04

Unexplained Weight Loss or Persistent Pain

Losing weight without trying, or pain that just won't go away, is always worth getting checked — even if nothing else feels wrong.

05

Genetic Predisposition

Some people are simply born with genes that raise their risk for certain cancers — no matter how healthy their lifestyle is.
